task_type: multilingual business-detail UX repair and production release
requested_outcome: Deliver polished business-detail pages in Hebrew, English, Russian and French, with a high-quality desktop review experience and no mixed-language or overflowing controls.
authorization_boundary: Implementation, verification and one production publication to the temporary VII site are authorized. Verified supplier facts, media, actions, database bindings and booking behavior must remain unchanged.
lifecycle_hooks: disabled by explicit account configuration; the correction is attached directly to this task contract

lesson_bundle.reason: A public detail-page family is being changed.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify every shared detail template and preserve all existing actions.

lesson_bundle.reason: A build cannot prove language or layout quality.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inspect the exact deployed release in all four languages.

lesson_bundle.reason: Long localized labels affect responsive controls.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height dialog states.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reviews redesign is visual and interaction-heavy.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require visible desktop and mobile evidence plus independent review.

lesson_bundle.reason: Hebrew typography must never fall back to a serif face.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Run source and first-paint font checks on the exact candidate.

lesson_bundle.reason: Translation must be native and complete, not mixed-language DOM replacement.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Block non-Hebrew routes containing untranslated interface Hebrew.

lesson_bundle.reason: The review component and detail navigation are shared.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Expand regression to vacation, event, spa, hourly, provider and activity detail pages.
Report success only after exact public release and rollback evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: English, Russian or French pages still contain Hebrew interface text.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use explicit localized copy for review states and translate dynamic data at render time.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Automated Hebrew-residue scans pass on representative non-Hebrew detail routes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Reviews still look like a long unstructured wall on desktop.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create a balanced summary and readable review grid with bounded cards and progressive disclosure.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop capture shows clear hierarchy, readable card widths and a visible primary action.

predicted_rejections.rejection: French or Russian buttons overflow or force uneven controls.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Allow protected wrapping, flexible minimum widths and language-safe button sizing.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No horizontal overflow or clipped text at desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height dialog viewports.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A fix on vacation pages leaves event, spa or provider details broken.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Repair shared components and verify each detail template family.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation, event, spa, hourly, provider and activity representatives pass the same language and layout checks.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The change is reported from source or build output only.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish one immutable candidate and inspect exact production URLs.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Release identity, rollback identity, public HTTP checks and independent Seal approval are recorded.

affected_family: spa, hourly, provider and activity discovery pages
shared review display and review submission dialog
sticky detail navigation, breadcrumbs, gallery labels, booking and contact actions
Hebrew, English, Russian and French routes
desktop, 390-pixel mobile, low-height, loading, empty, error and success states

midpoint_gate.trigger: After localized review copy and representative page chrome are implemented, before production build.
checks: review display and form expose explicit four-language copy
dynamic names, descriptions, features and status strings use locale-aware rendering
review and action controls have protected wrapping and no fixed-width clipping
focused component and localization tests pass

attack_questions: Can a dynamic business name create a mixed Hebrew heading on an English route?
Can a Russian or French label escape a button or dialog?
Can a review body force an unreadably wide or tall desktop card?
Can opening, submitting, failing, retrying or closing the review dialog break focus or language?
Can one detail world still use stale Hebrew navigation labels?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exercise representative deployed detail routes in all four languages, including reviews and long-label controls.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full build, typography audit, desktop/mobile captures, Hebrew-residue scan and independent exact-release review.

effectiveness.baseline: Release 424 English vacation detail visibly contains mixed Hebrew UI, Hebrew review chrome and untranslated dynamic content; desktop reviews form a long single-column wall.
